4-login-1.tsx.notes: Scaffold > Center > ConstrainedBox(maxWidth 320) > Padding(16) > stretch Column: outer box is 320 wide, so fields and button are 288 wide, which is still within the brief.

runtime.why: No Scaffold/Material in the tree: TextField asserts 'No Material widget found' unless the parent supplies a Material ancestor, and centering on screen relies on the parent giving it the full screen.

4-login-2.tsx.notes: Root is a bare Center with no Scaffold/Material, so it only works when the host wraps it in one (otherwise the TextField assertion fires and Text falls back to the unstyled default).

4-login-3.tsx.notes: Center > SingleChildScrollView > Padding > ConstrainedBox(maxWidth 320) > stretch Column lays out correctly (form 320 wide, scroll view shrink-wraps and is centered); helper sits in a nested Column directly under the password field.
